chapter: Day jobs and Bay Area gigs
title: New Orleans musicians passing through the Bay Area
summary: Few old friends came through, mostly Navy bands at Treasure Island during the war.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Any of the New Orleans musicians come through town in those days? Did you see any old friends? Not many. These guys you grew up with?
Did you lose touch with them? Not many. With that whole scene?

Not many really out here now that I grew up. There's one Tom Johnson. He's not playing anymore at the time. But he's out here. He came out here pretty. A lot of them came out with the bands, with the Navy band during the war. And they had a lot of New Orleans bands at the Treasure Island that came out here. I think even Willie Humphrey came out here with the band at that time during the war. And that's when I saw some of them. There was Oliver Alcorn. There was Alvin Alcorn's brother. He came out with the band during that time.
